Stage 3 · Java foundations

Scope & Lifetime

Braces are hotel rooms. Inner sees outer; outer never sees inner.

⏱ 12 min🧠 No experience needed🧪 Interactive
Step 1

Lobby vs diary

Checkout deletes everything inside.

🏨

Hotel. Lobby whiteboard (outer) visible from every room; room diary (inner) dies at checkout }. No snooping across braces — share via parameters and returns only.

hall vs room
public class Main {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    int hall = 1; // lobby: visible everywhere below
    if (true) {
      int room = 2; // room: dies at the closing brace
      System.out.println(hall + room); // 3: inner sees outer
    }
    System.out.println(hall); // 1: outer never saw room
    // System.out.println(room); // COMPILE ERROR: checked out
  }
}
Inner sees outer (prints 3). Outer never sees inner (the commented line would NOT compile).
